def draw_all(robot: Robot, start=0):
    strokes = build_contacts()
    for i in range(start, len(strokes)):
        draw_stroke(robot, strokes[i], i + 1)


def prepare(robot: Robot):
    """Load the brush and calibrate three pressures on the unscored practice sheet."""
    move_to(robot, [INK_CENTER[0], INK_CENTER[1], 0.25], speed=0.04, settle_s=0.25)
    move_to(robot, [INK_CENTER[0], INK_CENTER[1], 0.018], speed=0.018, settle_s=0.8)
    move_to(robot, [INK_CENTER[0], INK_CENTER[1], 0.25], speed=0.025, settle_s=0.4)

    def practice_xy(u, v):
        pix_m = 0.45 / 1834.508
        return np.array([-0.1 - (v - 512) * pix_m,
                         -0.1856 - (u - 256) * pix_m])

    for v, z in ((400, 0.018), (520, 0.013), (650, 0.008)):
        a, b = practice_xy(85, v), practice_xy(425, v)
        move_to(robot, [a[0], a[1], 0.055], speed=0.04, settle_s=0.25)
        move_to(robot, [a[0], a[1], z], speed=0.018, settle_s=0.20)
        move_to(robot, [b[0], b[1], z], speed=0.025, settle_s=0.15)
        move_to(robot, [b[0], b[1], 0.055], speed=0.025, settle_s=0.30)
        move_to(robot, [INK_CENTER[0], INK_CENTER[1], 0.25], speed=0.05, settle_s=0.25)


def main():
    robot = Robot()
    prepare(robot)
    draw_all(robot)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

I wrote and ran the trajectory with one client, using 10 main-sheet contacts. The record script is at [gen.py](/app/output/gen.py).

My camera-based estimate after aligning the ink was IoU ≈ 0.57, boundary F ≈ 0.50, and stray ink ≈ 0.15, so the drawing likely misses the picture thresholds. The planned path is about 630 mm, within the path limit. The service does not expose the grader’s final score.
